commands.author: hugenshen

target.title: fix(line): cap user profile cache
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an unbounded in-process **`userProfileCache`** in the LINE send path (`extensions/line/src/send.ts`). Profile lookups are cached for 5 minutes (TTL) but had no entry-count cap, so gateways serving many distinct LINE users accumulate Map entries indefinitely.

**Concrete scenario:** A LINE gateway processing inbound messages from 10 000 distinct users over several hours caches each `getUserProfile` result. With no size cap, the cache grows to 10 000+ entries and does not shrink until the gateway restarts.

## Why This Change Was Made

Extracts a `cacheLineUserProfile` writer helper that:

1. Deletes the existing entry for `userId` when present (refreshes insertion order for re-fetched profiles)
2. Sets the new profile entry (newest insertion position)
3. Calls `pruneMapToMaxSize` (from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/collection-runtime`) to evict the oldest-inserted entry until the map is at or under **1 024 entries**

The cap constant `LINE_USER_PROFILE_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 1024` is wired only in `cacheLineUserProfile`; TTL logic in `getUserProfile` is unchanged.

**Eviction semantics:** The cache uses insertion-order-on-write eviction, not pure LRU. Entries are moved to newest position when they are re-fetched from the LINE API (TTL miss or force-fetch). Read-only cache hits do not refresh insertion order, so a valid cached profile that has not been re-fetched can be evicted when 1 024 newer distinct users fill the cache. This is the documented behavior of `pruneMapToMaxSize` (first iterated entry → oldest insertion → evicted first) and is an acceptable trade-off for bounded memory without scan overhead on every read.

## User Impact

**Before:** Long-lived LINE gateways accumulate one `userProfileCache` entry per distinct user indefinitely, growing Map memory without bound.

**After:** The cache is capped at 1 024 entries. Entries evict in insertion order once the cap is exceeded. A re-fetched profile is refreshed to newest position; a cache hit does not change its eviction rank. Behavior is unchanged for the first 1 024 distinct users seen in a gateway lifecycle.

## Evidence

- `extensions/line/src/send.ts:28` — `LINE_USER_PROFILE_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 1024`
- `extensions/line/src/send.ts:33–43` — `cacheLineUserProfile`: delete + set + `pruneMapToMaxSize`
- `extensions/line/src/send.ts:524` — `getUserProfile` now calls `cacheLineUserProfile` instead of bare `userProfileCache.set`
- `extensions/line/src/send.ts:540–542` — `resetLineUserProfileCacheForTests` export (test isolation only)
- `src/infra/map-size.ts:13` — `pruneMapToMaxSize` iterates insertion order and deletes the first key until the map fits
- Diff: +39/−1 across 2 files (source +17, tests +21, plus one `beforeEach` reset line)

### Behavior proof

All tests below were run against PR head commit `aaf69e5d98116c41a40206f3b0f66aaaef4271a0` on Node v22.22.0, pnpm 11.2.2 (macOS Darwin 24.3.0 arm64, 2026-07-08T05:24:12Z). The SHA can be independently verified:

```bash
git rev-parse HEAD
# aaf69e5d98116c41a40206f3b0f66aaaef4271a0
```

#### 1) Profile cache eviction regression — targeted verbose

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/line/src/send.test.ts -t "evicts oldest" --reporter=verbose

 RUN  v4.1.9

 ↓ |extension-line| ... > LINE send helpers > limits quick reply items to 13
 ↓ |extension-line| ... > LINE send helpers > caches profile results by default
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > evicts oldest profile cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap 23ms
 ↓ |extension-line| ... > (12 other tests skipped)

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed | 15 skipped (16)
   Start at  13:24:12
   Duration  909ms (transform 402ms, setup 91ms, import 3ms, tests 752ms, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 3.70s
```

Regression flow:
1. Fetch `U-first` → `getProfileMock` called **1×** (cached at insertion position 0)
2. Fetch `U-fill-1` … `U-fill-1024` → **1024** more API calls (**1025** total; cache now at cap 1024 with `U-first` evicted)
3. Re-fetch `U-first` → `getProfileMock` called **1×** again, confirming the entry was evicted and not still cached

#### 2) Full touched test file — 16/16 green

```text
$ pnpm test extensions/line/src/send.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 RUN  v4.1.9

 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > limits quick reply items to 13 23ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > truncates quick reply labels without leaving lone surrogates 0ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > pushes images via normalized LINE target 1ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > replies when reply token is provided 1ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > sends video with explicit image preview URL 0ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > throws when video preview URL is missing 1ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > blocks private-network media URLs before calling LINE 0ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > omits trackingId for non-user destinations 0ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > throws when push messages are empty 0ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > rejects lowercased LINE-shaped recipients (#81628 safety net) 0ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > accepts case-exact LINE recipients with the leading capital preserved 0ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > logs HTTP body when push fails 0ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > caches profile results by default 0ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > evicts oldest profile cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap 4ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > continues when loading animation is unsupported 0ms
 ✓ |extension-line| extensions/line/src/send.test.ts > LINE send helpers > pushes quick-reply text and caps to 13 buttons 0ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  16 passed (16)
   Start at  13:24:04
   Duration  1.03s (transform 505ms, setup 109ms, import 3ms, tests 851ms, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 4.44s
```

**Reproducible validation transcript:** Independently reproducible against the exact PR head SHA:

```bash
git checkout aaf69e5d98116c41a40206f3b0f66aaaef4271a0
pnpm test extensions/line/src/send.test.ts --reporter=verbose
# Expected: Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 16 passed (16)
```

**Proof gap:** No redacted live LINE Messaging API profile-fetch logs in this validation environment. Crabbox/Testbox remote CI was unavailable at time of submission; the reproducible Vitest transcript above (exact SHA pinned, eviction regression flow proven end-to-end) is the available behavioral proof. Optional supplemental proof is a gateway log under sustained distinct-user traffic showing cache size stabilizing at ≤ 1 024 entries.

**Eviction semantics clarification (addressing ClawSweeper [P3]):** The implementation is insertion-order-on-write, not access-order LRU. `cacheLineUserProfile` uses `delete` + `set` to move a re-fetched entry to newest position before pruning; valid TTL-hit reads do not call this helper and do not refresh insertion order. This is correct and documented behavior for `pruneMapToMaxSize`. The existing eviction regression test validates FIFO-on-write semantics (fill past cap → oldest inserted entry evicted), not read-order LRU. No code change is needed; only the wording is updated above.
